# Pix Engineer

> AI-powered platform to build full-stack web apps from text prompts, convert designs to production-ready code, and craft AI prompts — all in one place.

Pix Engineer combines three tools for product builders and developers: an AI App Builder that turns prompts into working Next.js / React / HTML apps, a Design-to-Code converter that turns screenshots, wireframes, and Figma exports into responsive HTML / Tailwind / React code, and a Prompt Engineer that generates, improves, and analyzes prompts for LLMs.

## Pages

- [Home — AI App Builder](/): Generate full-stack apps from natural-language prompts.
- [Design to Code](/design-to-code): Upload a design and get pixel-perfect, responsive code.
- [Prompt Engineer](/prompt-engineer): Generate, improve, and analyze prompts for any LLM.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Free tier plus credit-based plans.
- [About](/about): What Pix Engineer is and who it's for.
- [Contact](/contact): Support, partnerships, and inquiries.
- [Blog](/blog): Tutorials and articles on AI app building, design-to-code, and prompt engineering.
